svg.title: What a user with tags sees
svg.desc: Paperless Sync lets katja see only the documents with the tag Katja. katja searches for invoice, and the search asks Paperless only for the documents with that tag. It checks the tags of each document that comes back: a document without the tag Katja stays hidden, not among her tags, even when a share of the archive shows katja its file. A document with the tag shows when katja can open its file, her own copy that Paperless Sync writes or a file of the archive account shared with her read-only, and otherwise stays hidden without a file. A user without a line, such as the administrator, sees every document as before.
